# ezghcloud Provider

Manage EZGH Cloud infrastructure and IAM through its public APIs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ezghcloud = {
      source = "ezgamehost/ezghcloud"
    }
  }
}

# Set EZGHCLOUD_API_TOKEN and EZGHCLOUD_ORGANIZATION_ID in the environment.
provider "ezghcloud" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Customer bearer credential. Defaults to EZGHCLOUD_API_TOKEN. The credential is never stored as a resource attribute.
- `endpoints` (Map of String) Optional API base URL overrides by service: orgs, compute, network, firewall, blockstore, images, databases, files, dns, certificates, kubernetes, lb, waf. Credentials are sent to these URLs; use trusted endpoints only. Defaults to public HTTPS APIs.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to EZGHCLOUD_ORGANIZATION_ID. Use provider aliases for multiple organizations.
